# Welcome!

I am an assistant professor in the [Research, Evaluation, Statistics and Assessment (RESA)](https://www.usm.edu/graduate-programs/educational-research.php){target="_blank"} program at [The University of Southern Mississippi](https://www.usm.edu){target="_blank"}. I earned a Ph.D. in education policy from the [University of Pennsylvania Graduate School of Education](https://www.gse.upenn.edu){target="_blank"} with a dual M.A. in statistics from the [Wharton School](https://www.wharton.upenn.edu){target="_blank"} in 2026. 

I study the causal impacts of policies on students, families and school systems using rigorous experimental and quasi-experimental research designs. I focus largely on K&#8209;12 education funding and other policies that affect resource allocation, though my work covers a range of additional topics. I recently led the quantitative analyses for a [national randomized impact evaluation of public Montessori preschool](https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2506130122){target="_blank"}, published in the *Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (PNAS)*.

I received the [AERA--NSF Dissertation Grant Award](https://www.aera.net/Newsroom/AERA-Highlights-E-newsletter/AERA-Highlights-March-2026/AERANSF-Grants-Program-Announces-New-Award-Recipients) for my dissertation on federal, state and local education finance policies. I was also an [Institute of Education Sciences Predoctoral Fellow](https://www.gse.upenn.edu/student-life/enhancing-your-journey/research-opportunities/institute-education-sciences-predoctoral-training-program) during my studies.
